items.title: Apple’s Betting Improved Heart and Health Insights Will Boost Watch Sales
items.summary: Like runners striving to break from the pack, a slew of wearables companies are competing for share of consumers’ health and fitness tracking habits.  With  Apple  latest heart-rate focused updates to its best-selling Apple Watch and an upcoming Health app redesign, it’s hoping to expand an already impressive lead.  Users will be able to calculate their “health age”—a comparison of their overall health measurements with their actual age—as well as a Readiness score that gauges capacity for strenuous activity.
